79def kubernetes_audit(raw: dict) -> dict:
80    user = _dict(raw.get("user"))
81    object_ref = _dict(raw.get("objectRef"))
82    request_object = _dict(raw.get("requestObject"))
83    metadata = _dict(request_object.get("metadata"))
84    annotations = _dict(metadata.get("annotations"))
85    supplied = _dict(raw.get("attributes"))
86    verb = _text(raw.get("verb"), raw.get("action"), default="unknown").lower()
87    resource = _text(object_ref.get("resource"), default="resource").lower()
88    if raw.get("event_type"):
89        event_type = _event_type(raw["event_type"], "KUBERNETES_AUDIT")
90    elif verb in {"create", "update", "patch"} and resource == "clusterrolebindings":
91        event_type = "CLUSTER_ROLE_BINDING"
92    elif verb in {"get", "list", "watch"} and resource == "secrets":
93        event_type = "SECRET_ACCESS"
94    elif verb == "create" and resource == "pods":
95        event_type = "POD_CREATE"
96    else:
97        event_type = _event_type(f"K8S_{verb}_{resource}", "KUBERNETES_AUDIT")
98 
99    spec = _dict(request_object.get("spec"))
100    containers = list(spec.get("containers") or []) + list(spec.get("initContainers") or [])
101    privileged = any(bool(_dict(_dict(c).get("securityContext")).get("privileged")) for c in containers)
102    namespace = object_ref.get("namespace") or metadata.get("namespace")
103    role_ref = _dict(request_object.get("roleRef"))
104    attributes = {
105        "cluster_role": _text(supplied.get("cluster_role"), role_ref.get("name"), object_ref.get("name")),
106        "change_approved": bool(supplied.get("change_approved", annotations.get("governance.example/approved") == "true")),
107        "cross_namespace": bool(supplied.get("cross_namespace", False)),
108        "privileged": bool(supplied.get("privileged", privileged)),
109        "image_approved": bool(supplied.get("image_approved", annotations.get("governance.example/image-approved") == "true")),
110        **supplied,
111    }
112    actor_id = _text(_dict(raw.get("actor")).get("id"), user.get("username"), default="unknown")
113    return {
114        "source_id": raw.get("auditID") or raw.get("event_id"),
115        "event_time": _time(raw) or raw.get("stageTimestamp"),
116        "event_type": event_type,
117        "actor": {
118            "id": actor_id,
119            "type": "SERVICE" if actor_id.startswith("system:serviceaccount:") else "USER",
120            "roles": user.get("groups", []),
121            "ip": (raw.get("sourceIPs") or [None])[0],
122            "namespace": namespace,
123        },
124        "subject": _subject(raw, default_type=resource.upper(), default_id=_text(object_ref.get("name"), object_ref.get("uid"), default=resource), namespace=namespace),
125        "action": verb,
126        "outcome": "FAILURE" if int(_dict(raw.get("responseStatus")).get("code", 200)) >= 400 else "SUCCESS",
127        "environment": _environment(raw),
128        "correlation_id": _text(raw.get("correlation_id"), raw.get("auditID"), default=f"kubernetes:{actor_id}"),
129        "trace_id": raw.get("trace_id"),
130        "attributes": attributes,
131        "labels": _labels(raw, "kubernetes-audit"),
132    }

1from __future__ import annotations

3from datetime import datetime, timezone
4from hashlib import sha256

11from threading import Lock, Thread

22def _utc_now() -> str:
23    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
24 
25 
26def _iso_time(value) -> str:
27    if value is None:
28        return _utc_now()
29    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
30        seconds = value / 1000 if value > 10_000_000_000 else value
31        return datetime.fromtimestamp(seconds, timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
32    text = str(value).strip()
33    if text.isdigit():
34        return _iso_time(int(text))
35    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
36    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
37        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
38    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

41def _kafka_config(client_id: str) -> dict:
42    protocol = os.getenv("KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL", "PLAINTEXT")
43    config = {
44        "bootstrap.servers": os.getenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", "localhost:19092"),
45        "security.protocol": protocol,
46        "client.id": client_id,
47        "enable.idempotence": True,
48        "acks": "all",
49        "compression.type": "zstd",
50        "linger.ms": 20,
51    }
52    if protocol != "PLAINTEXT":
53        from aws_msk_iam_sasl_signer import MSKAuthTokenProvider
54 
55        region = os.environ["AWS_REGION"]
56 
57        def oauth_cb(_):
58            token, expiry_ms = MSKAuthTokenProvider.generate_auth_token(region)
59            return token, expiry_ms / 1000
60 
61        config.update({"sasl.mechanism": "OAUTHBEARER", "oauth_cb": oauth_cb})
62    return config

65def build_governance_event(raw: dict, producer_name: str, mapper: Mapper) -> dict:
66    mapped = mapper(raw)
67    source_id = mapped.pop("source_id", None)
68    if source_id:
69        event_id = str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, f"governance:{producer_name}:{source_id}"))
70    else:
71        event_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
72    event_time = _iso_time(mapped.get("event_time"))
73    mapped["event_time"] = event_time
74    mapped["outcome"] = str(mapped.get("outcome", "UNKNOWN")).upper()
75    if mapped["outcome"] not in {"SUCCESS", "FAILURE", "UNKNOWN"}:
76        mapped["outcome"] = "UNKNOWN"
77    return {
78        "schema_version": "1.0",
79        "event_id": event_id,
80        "event_time": event_time,
81        "ingested_at": _utc_now(),
82        "producer": producer_name,
83        **mapped,
84    }
85 
86 
87class Adapter:
88    def __init__(self, producer_name: str, topic: str, mapper: Mapper):
89        self.producer_name = producer_name
90        self.topic = topic
91        self.mapper = mapper
92        self.producer = Producer(_kafka_config(f"{producer_name.lower()}-adapter"))
93        schema_path = Path(os.getenv("GOVERNANCE_SCHEMA_PATH", "/app/governance-event.schema.json"))
94        self.validator = Draft202012Validator(json.loads(schema_path.read_text()), format_checker=FormatChecker())
95        self.accepted = 0
96        self.rejected = 0
97        self.lock = Lock()
98 
99    @staticmethod
100    def expand(payload) -> list[dict]:
101        if isinstance(payload, list):
102            return payload
103        if isinstance(payload, dict) and isinstance(payload.get("items"), list):
104            return payload["items"]
105        if isinstance(payload, dict) and isinstance(payload.get("events"), list):
106            return payload["events"]
107        if isinstance(payload, dict):
108            return [payload]
109        raise ValueError("Request body must be an event object or event array")
110 
111    def ready(self) -> bool:
112        try:
113            # confluent-kafka dispatches the Python OAuth callback from poll().
114            # Prime the callback before the blocking metadata lookup.
115            for _ in range(10):
116                self.producer.poll(0.1)
117            self.producer.list_topics(topic=self.topic, timeout=2)
118            return True
119        except Exception:
120            return False
121 
122    def _dead_letter(self, raw: dict, error: Exception) -> None:
123        source_id = raw.get("id") or raw.get("event_id") or raw.get("request_id") or raw.get("auditID")
124        fingerprint = sha256(json.dumps(raw, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()
125        payload = {
126            "producer": self.producer_name,
127            "source_id": str(source_id) if source_id else None,
128            "payload_fingerprint": fingerprint,
129            "error": str(error)[:1000],
130            "received_at": _utc_now(),
131        }
132        self.producer.produce("governance.dead-letter.v1", value=json.dumps(payload).encode())
133        self.producer.flush(5)
134 
135    def publish(self, payload) -> list[str]:
136        event_ids = []
137        for raw in self.expand(payload):
138            try:
139                event = build_governance_event(raw, self.producer_name, self.mapper)
140                self.validator.validate(event)
141                subject = event["subject"]
142                key = event["actor"]["id"]
143                if subject.get("model_name") and subject.get("model_version"):
144                    key = f'{subject["model_name"]}:{subject["model_version"]}'
145                timestamp_ms = int(datetime.fromisoformat(event["event_time"].replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp() * 1000)
146                self.producer.produce(
147                    self.topic,
148                    key=key.encode(),
149                    value=json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":")).encode(),
150                    timestamp=timestamp_ms,
151                )
152                event_ids.append(event["event_id"])
153            except Exception as error:
154                with self.lock:
155                    self.rejected += 1
156                self._dead_letter(raw, error)
157                raise
158        if self.producer.flush(10) != 0:
159            raise RuntimeError("Kafka delivery timed out")
160        with self.lock:
161            self.accepted += len(event_ids)
162        return event_ids
163 
164 
165def serve(producer_name: str, topic: str, mapper: Mapper) -> None:
166    adapter = Adapter(producer_name, os.getenv("KAFKA_TOPIC", topic), mapper)
167 
168    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
169        def _json(self, status: int, body: dict):
170            encoded = json.dumps(body).encode()
171            self.send_response(status)
172            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
173            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(encoded)))
174            self.end_headers()
175            self.wfile.write(encoded)
176 
177        def do_GET(self):
178            if self.path == "/healthz":
179                self._json(HTTPStatus.OK, {"status": "ok", "producer": producer_name})
180            elif self.path == "/readyz":
181                ready = adapter.ready()
182                self._json(HTTPStatus.OK if ready else HTTPStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, {"ready": ready})
183            elif self.path == "/metrics":
184                body = (
185                    f'governance_adapter_events_total{{producer="{producer_name}",result="accepted"}} {adapter.accepted}\n'
186                    f'governance_adapter_events_total{{producer="{producer_name}",result="rejected"}} {adapter.rejected}\n'
187                ).encode()
188                self.send_response(HTTPStatus.OK)
189                self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; version=0.0.4")
190                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
191                self.end_headers()
192                self.wfile.write(body)
193            else:
194                self._json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "not found"})
195 
196        def do_POST(self):
197            if self.path != "/events":
198                self._json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "not found"})
199                return
200            try:
201                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
202                if length <= 0 or length > int(os.getenv("MAX_REQUEST_BYTES", "1048576")):
203                    raise ValueError("Request body is empty or exceeds the configured limit")
204                payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
205                event_ids = adapter.publish(payload)
206                self._json(HTTPStatus.ACCEPTED, {"accepted": len(event_ids), "event_ids": event_ids})
207            except Exception as error:
208                self._json(HTTPStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, {"error": str(error)[:1000]})
209 
210        def log_message(self, format, *args):
211            return
212 
213    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", int(os.getenv("PORT", "8080"))), Handler)
214    def stop(*_):
215        Thread(target=server.shutdown, daemon=True).start()
216 
217    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
218    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
219    server.serve_forever()

1from __future__ import annotations
2 
3import json
4import os
5import signal
6 
7from confluent_kafka import Consumer, KafkaError, Producer
8 
9from scorer import scorer_from_environment
10 
11 
12INPUT_TOPIC = "governance.findings.raw.v1"
13OUTPUT_TOPIC = "governance.findings.scored.v1"
14running = True
15 
16 
17def kafka_config(client: str) -> dict:
18    config = {
19        "bootstrap.servers": os.getenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", "localhost:19092"),
20        "security.protocol": os.getenv("KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL", "PLAINTEXT"),
21        "client.id": f"governance-risk-{client}",
22    }
23    if config["security.protocol"] != "PLAINTEXT":
24        from aws_msk_iam_sasl_signer import MSKAuthTokenProvider
25 
26        region = os.environ["AWS_REGION"]
27 
28        def oauth_cb(_):
29            token, expiry_ms = MSKAuthTokenProvider.generate_auth_token(region)
30            return token, expiry_ms / 1000
31 
32        config.update({"sasl.mechanism": "OAUTHBEARER", "oauth_cb": oauth_cb})
33    return config
34 
35 
36def stop(*_):
37    global running
38    running = False
39 
40 
41def main() -> None:
42    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
43    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
44    consumer = Consumer({
45        **kafka_config("consumer"),
46        "group.id": os.getenv("KAFKA_GROUP_ID", "governance-risk-scorer-v1"),
47        "auto.offset.reset": "earliest",
48        "enable.auto.commit": False,
49    })
50    producer = Producer({**kafka_config("producer"), "enable.idempotence": True, "acks": "all"})
51    scorer = scorer_from_environment()
52    consumer.subscribe([INPUT_TOPIC])
53    try:
54        while running:
55            message = consumer.poll(1.0)
56            if message is None:
57                continue
58            if message.error():
59                if message.error().code() not in (KafkaError._PARTITION_EOF, KafkaError.UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PART):
60                    raise RuntimeError(message.error())
61                continue
62            finding = json.loads(message.value())
63            scored = scorer.score(finding)
64            producer.produce(
65                OUTPUT_TOPIC,
66                key=scored["finding_id"].encode(),
67                value=json.dumps(scored, separators=(",", ":")).encode(),
68            )
69            producer.flush(10)
70            consumer.commit(message=message, asynchronous=False)
71    finally:
72        consumer.close()
73        producer.flush(10)
74 
75 
76if __name__ == "__main__":
77    main()

1from __future__ import annotations
2 
3from collections import deque
4from datetime import datetime, timezone
5import math
6import os
7from typing import Any
8 
9import numpy as np
10from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
11 
12 
13RULES = [f"GOV-{number:03d}" for number in range(1, 17)]
14PRODUCERS = ["KEYCLOAK", "KUBERNETES", "PIPELINE", "MODEL_REGISTRY", "LLM_GATEWAY"]
15 
16 
17class OnlineIsolationScorer:
18    """Bounded-history Isolation Forest with deterministic retraining."""
19 
20    def __init__(self, min_samples: int = 32, retrain_every: int = 25, history_size: int = 1000):
21        self.min_samples = min_samples
22        self.retrain_every = retrain_every
23        self.history: deque[list[float]] = deque(maxlen=history_size)
24        self.model: IsolationForest | None = None
25        self.since_fit = 0
26 
27    def score(self, finding: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
28        finding = self.normalize_timestamps(finding)
29        vector = self.features(finding)
30        self.history.append(vector)
31        self.since_fit += 1
32        if len(self.history) >= self.min_samples and (self.model is None or self.since_fit >= self.retrain_every):
33            self.model = IsolationForest(
34                n_estimators=200,
35                max_samples=min(256, len(self.history)),
36                contamination="auto",
37                random_state=42,
38                n_jobs=1,
39            ).fit(np.asarray(self.history, dtype=float))
40            self.since_fit = 0
41 
42        baseline = float(finding["baseline_risk"])
43        if self.model is None:
44            ml_risk = None
45            status = f"warming:{len(self.history)}/{self.min_samples}"
46            recommended = baseline
47            delta = None
48        else:
49            decision = float(self.model.decision_function(np.asarray([vector], dtype=float))[0])
50            ml_risk = round(float(np.clip(50.0 - 100.0 * decision, 0.0, 100.0)), 2)
51            status = "ready"
52            recommended = round(max(baseline, ml_risk), 2)
53            delta = round(ml_risk - baseline, 2)
54 
55        return {
56            **finding,
57            "isolation_forest_risk": ml_risk,
58            "risk_delta": delta,
59            "recommended_risk": recommended,
60            "model_status": status,
61        }
62 
63    @staticmethod
64    def normalize_timestamps(finding: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
65        normalized = dict(finding)
66        for field in ("source_event_time", "detected_at", "window_start", "window_end"):
67            value = normalized.get(field)
68            if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
69                normalized[field] = datetime.fromtimestamp(value, timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
70        return normalized
71 
72    @staticmethod
73    def features(finding: dict[str, Any]) -> list[float]:
74        rule_one_hot = [1.0 if finding.get("rule_id") == rule else 0.0 for rule in RULES]
75        producer_one_hot = [1.0 if finding.get("producer") == producer else 0.0 for producer in PRODUCERS]
76        at = datetime.fromisoformat(str(finding["source_event_time"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
77        angle = 2.0 * math.pi * at.hour / 24.0
78        numeric = [
79            float(finding["severity"]) / 5.0,
80            float(finding["frequency_band"]) / 5.0,
81            float(finding["baseline_risk"]) / 100.0,
82            math.sin(angle),
83            math.cos(angle),
84        ]
85        return numeric + rule_one_hot + producer_one_hot
86 
87 
88def scorer_from_environment() -> OnlineIsolationScorer:
89    return OnlineIsolationScorer(
90        min_samples=int(os.getenv("RISK_MODEL_MIN_SAMPLES", "32")),
91        retrain_every=int(os.getenv("RISK_MODEL_RETRAIN_EVERY", "25")),
92        history_size=int(os.getenv("RISK_MODEL_HISTORY_SIZE", "1000")),
93    )

1package io.governance;
2 
3import io.governance.rules.RuleCatalog;
4import io.governance.streams.GovernanceTopology;
5import org.apache.kafka.clients.admin.Admin;
6import org.apache.kafka.clients.admin.NewTopic;
7import org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serdes;
8import org.apache.kafka.common.errors.TopicExistsException;
9import org.apache.kafka.streams.KafkaStreams;
10import org.apache.kafka.streams.StreamsConfig;
11import org.apache.kafka.streams.errors.LogAndContinueExceptionHandler;
12 
13import java.time.Duration;
14import java.util.List;
15import java.util.Map;
16import java.util.Properties;
17import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
18import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
19import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
20import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
21 
22public final class Application {
23    public static void main(String[] args) {
24        Properties properties = propertiesFromEnvironment();
25        ensureTopics(properties);
26        KafkaStreams streams = new KafkaStreams(new GovernanceTopology(RuleCatalog.load()).build(), properties);
27        CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
28        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
29            streams.close(Duration.ofSeconds(20));
30            latch.countDown();
31        }));
32        streams.setUncaughtExceptionHandler(exception -> KafkaStreams.State.ERROR == streams.state()
33                ? org.apache.kafka.streams.errors.StreamsUncaughtExceptionHandler.StreamThreadExceptionResponse.SHUTDOWN_APPLICATION
34                : org.apache.kafka.streams.errors.StreamsUncaughtExceptionHandler.StreamThreadExceptionResponse.REPLACE_THREAD);
35        streams.start();
36        try { latch.await(); }
37        catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
38    }
39 
40    static void ensureTopics(Properties streamProperties) {
41        Properties adminProperties = new Properties();
42        for (String key : List.of(
43                "bootstrap.servers", "security.protocol", "sasl.mechanism",
44                "sasl.jaas.config", "sasl.client.callback.handler.class")) {
45            if (streamProperties.containsKey(key)) adminProperties.put(key, streamProperties.get(key));
46        }
47        int partitions = Integer.parseInt(env("KAFKA_TOPIC_PARTITIONS", "6"));
48        short replication = Short.parseShort(env("KAFKA_INTERNAL_REPLICATION_FACTOR", "3"));
49        List<String> names = List.of(
50                "governance.keycloak.v1",
51                "governance.kubernetes.v1",
52                "governance.pipeline.v1",
53                "governance.model-registry.v1",
54                "governance.llm-gateway.v1",
55                "governance.dead-letter.v1",
56                "governance.findings.raw.v1",
57                "governance.findings.scored.v1");
58 
59        try (Admin admin = Admin.create(adminProperties)) {
60            Map<String, org.apache.kafka.common.KafkaFuture<Void>> results = admin.createTopics(
61                    names.stream().map(name -> new NewTopic(name, partitions, replication)).toList()).values();
62            for (Map.Entry<String, org.apache.kafka.common.KafkaFuture<Void>> entry : results.entrySet()) {
63                try {
64                    entry.getValue().get(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
65                    System.out.println("Created Kafka topic " + entry.getKey());
66                } catch (ExecutionException error) {
67                    if (!(error.getCause() instanceof TopicExistsException)) {
68                        throw new IllegalStateException("Could not create Kafka topic " + entry.getKey(), error.getCause());
69                    }
70                }
71            }
72        } catch (InterruptedException error) {
73            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
74            throw new IllegalStateException("Interrupted while creating Kafka topics", error);
75        } catch (TimeoutException error) {
76            throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out while creating Kafka topics", error);
77        }
78    }
79 
80    static Properties propertiesFromEnvironment() {
81        Properties p = new Properties();
82        p.put(StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_ID_CONFIG, env("KAFKA_APPLICATION_ID", "governance-rule-engine-v1"));
83        p.put(StreamsConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG, env("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", "localhost:19092"));
84        p.put(StreamsConfig.DEFAULT_KEY_SERDE_CLASS_CONFIG, Serdes.StringSerde.class);
85        p.put(StreamsConfig.PROCESSING_GUARANTEE_CONFIG, StreamsConfig.EXACTLY_ONCE_V2);
86        p.put(StreamsConfig.NUM_STREAM_THREADS_CONFIG, env("KAFKA_STREAM_THREADS", "2"));
87        p.put(StreamsConfig.STATE_DIR_CONFIG, env("KAFKA_STATE_DIR", "/tmp/kafka-streams"));
88        p.put(StreamsConfig.REPLICATION_FACTOR_CONFIG, env("KAFKA_INTERNAL_REPLICATION_FACTOR", "3"));
89        p.put(StreamsConfig.COMMIT_INTERVAL_MS_CONFIG, 1000);
90        p.put(StreamsConfig.DEFAULT_DESERIALIZATION_EXCEPTION_HANDLER_CLASS_CONFIG, LogAndContinueExceptionHandler.class);
91 
92        String protocol = env("KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL", "PLAINTEXT");
93        p.put("security.protocol", protocol);
94        if (!"PLAINTEXT".equals(protocol)) {
95            p.put("sasl.mechanism", env("KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM", "AWS_MSK_IAM"));
96            p.put("sasl.jaas.config", env("KAFKA_SASL_JAAS_CONFIG", "software.amazon.msk.auth.iam.IAMLoginModule required;"));
97            p.put("sasl.client.callback.handler.class", env("KAFKA_SASL_CALLBACK_HANDLER", "software.amazon.msk.auth.iam.IAMClientCallbackHandler"));
98        }
99        return p;
100    }
101 
102    private static String env(String key, String fallback) {
103        String value = System.getenv(key);
104        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? fallback : value;
105    }
106}

10@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = false)
11public record GovernanceEvent(
12        @JsonProperty("schema_version") String schemaVersion,
13        @JsonProperty("event_id") String eventId,
14        @JsonProperty("event_time") Instant eventTime,
15        @JsonProperty("ingested_at") Instant ingestedAt,
16        Producer producer,
17        @JsonProperty("event_type") String eventType,
18        Actor actor,

24        @JsonProperty("trace_id") String traceId,

26        Map<String, String> labels
27) {
28    public enum Producer { KEYCLOAK, KUBERNETES, PIPELINE, MODEL_REGISTRY, LLM_GATEWAY }
29    public enum Outcome { SUCCESS, FAILURE, UNKNOWN }
30

1package io.governance.model;
2 
3import java.time.Instant;
4 
5public record LoginBurst(
6        String firstEventId,
7        String thresholdEventId,
8        Instant thresholdEventTime,
9        String lastEventId,
10        Instant lastEventTime,
11        long count
12) {
13    public static LoginBurst add(LoginBurst current, GovernanceEvent event) {
14        if (current == null || current.count() == 0) {
15            return new LoginBurst(event.eventId(), null, null, event.eventId(), event.eventTime(), 1);
16        }
17        long nextCount = current.count() + 1;
18        String thresholdId = nextCount == 5 ? event.eventId() : current.thresholdEventId();
19        Instant thresholdTime = nextCount == 5 ? event.eventTime() : current.thresholdEventTime();
20        return new LoginBurst(
21                current.firstEventId(), thresholdId, thresholdTime,
22                event.eventId(), event.eventTime(), nextCount
23        );
24    }
25}

1package io.governance.risk;
2 
3public final class BaselineRiskScorer {
4    private BaselineRiskScorer() {}
5 
6    public static int frequencyBand(long frequency) {
7        if (frequency <= 1) return 1;
8        if (frequency <= 3) return 2;
9        if (frequency <= 7) return 3;
10        if (frequency <= 15) return 4;
11        return 5;
12    }
13 
14    public static double score(int severity, long frequency) {
15        int boundedSeverity = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, severity));
16        return boundedSeverity * frequencyBand(frequency) * 4.0;
17    }
18 
19    public static String label(int severity) {
20        return switch (severity) {
21            case 1 -> "low";
22            case 2, 3 -> "medium";
23            case 4 -> "high";
24            default -> "critical";
25        };
26    }
27}

14public final class FindingFactory {

17    public static ComplianceFinding create(
18            RuleDefinition rule, GovernanceEvent event, long frequency,
19            Instant windowStart, Instant windowEnd, Map<String, Object> extraEvidence
20    ) {
21        String identity = rule.id() + ":" + event.eventId() + ":" + (windowStart == null ? "event" : windowStart);
22        String findingId = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(identity.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).toString();

28        evidence.put("correlation_id", event.correlationId());
29        if (extraEvidence != null) evidence.putAll(extraEvidence);

33                Instant.now(), windowStart, windowEnd, rule.severity(), BaselineRiskScorer.label(rule.severity()),
34                frequency, frequencyBand, BaselineRiskScorer.score(rule.severity(), frequency),

1package io.governance.rules;

3import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference;
4import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
5import com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.yaml.YAMLFactory;

7 
8import java.io.InputStream;
9import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
10import java.util.List;
11import java.util.Map;
12 
13public final class RuleCatalog {
14    private final Map<String, RuleDefinition> rules;
15 
16    private RuleCatalog(Map<String, RuleDefinition> rules) { this.rules = Map.copyOf(rules); }
17 
18    public static RuleCatalog load() {
19        try (InputStream input = RuleCatalog.class.getResourceAsStream("/rules.yml")) {
20            if (input == null) throw new IllegalStateException("rules.yml is missing from the classpath");
21            ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper(new YAMLFactory());
22            Map<String, List<RuleDefinition>> root = mapper.readValue(input, new TypeReference<>() {});
23            Map<String, RuleDefinition> byId = new LinkedHashMap<>();
24            for (RuleDefinition definition : root.getOrDefault("rules", List.of())) byId.put(definition.id(), definition);
25            if (byId.size() != 16) throw new IllegalStateException("Expected 16 rules, found " + byId.size());
26            return new RuleCatalog(byId);
27        } catch (Exception e) {
28            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to load rule catalog", e);
29        }
30    }
31 
32    public RuleDefinition get(String id) {
33        RuleDefinition definition = rules.get(id);
34        if (definition == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown rule " + id);
35        return definition;
36    }
37 
38    public int size() { return rules.size(); }
39    public Map<String, RuleDefinition> all() { return rules; }
40}

1package io.governance.rules;
2 
3import io.governance.model.ComplianceFinding;
4import io.governance.model.GovernanceEvent;
5 
6import java.util.ArrayList;
7import java.util.List;
8import java.util.Map;
9 
10public final class StatelessRuleEngine {
11    private final RuleCatalog catalog;
12 
13    public StatelessRuleEngine(RuleCatalog catalog) { this.catalog = catalog; }
14 
15    public List<ComplianceFinding> evaluate(GovernanceEvent e) {
16        List<ComplianceFinding> findings = new ArrayList<>();
17        switch (e.producer()) {
18            case KEYCLOAK -> evaluateKeycloak(e, findings);
19            case KUBERNETES -> evaluateKubernetes(e, findings);
20            case PIPELINE -> evaluatePipeline(e, findings);
21            case MODEL_REGISTRY -> evaluateRegistry(e, findings);
22            case LLM_GATEWAY -> evaluateGateway(e, findings);
23        }
24        return findings;
25    }
26 
27    private void evaluateKeycloak(GovernanceEvent e, List<ComplianceFinding> out) {
28        if (is(e, "ROLE_GRANT") && bool(e, "privileged_role") && !bool(e, "change_approved")) add(out, "GOV-002", e);
29        if (is(e, "LOGIN_SUCCESS") && bool(e, "privileged_identity") && !bool(e, "mfa_used")) add(out, "GOV-003", e);
30    }
31 
32    private void evaluateKubernetes(GovernanceEvent e, List<ComplianceFinding> out) {
33        if (is(e, "CLUSTER_ROLE_BINDING") && "cluster-admin".equals(text(e, "cluster_role")) && !bool(e, "change_approved")) add(out, "GOV-004", e);
34        if (is(e, "SECRET_ACCESS") && bool(e, "cross_namespace")) add(out, "GOV-005", e);
35        if (is(e, "POD_CREATE") && (bool(e, "privileged") || !boolDefault(e, "image_approved", true))) add(out, "GOV-006", e);
36    }
37 
38    private void evaluatePipeline(GovernanceEvent e, List<ComplianceFinding> out) {
39        if (is(e, "DATASET_READ") && blank(text(e, "dataset_owner"))) add(out, "GOV-007", e);
40        if (is(e, "SCHEMA_CHANGE") && !bool(e, "version_bumped")) add(out, "GOV-008", e);
41        if (is(e, "DRIFT_EVALUATION") && number(e, "metric_value") > number(e, "threshold") && !"STARTED".equals(text(e, "remediation_status"))) add(out, "GOV-009", e);
42        if (is(e, "BIAS_EVALUATION") && number(e, "metric_value") > number(e, "threshold") && !bool(e, "approved_exception")) add(out, "GOV-010", e);
43    }
44 
45    private void evaluateRegistry(GovernanceEvent e, List<ComplianceFinding> out) {
46        if (is(e, "ARTIFACT_REGISTERED") && (!bool(e, "signature_verified") || blank(text(e, "sha256")))) add(out, "GOV-013", e);
47    }
48 
49    private void evaluateGateway(GovernanceEvent e, List<ComplianceFinding> out) {
50        if (is(e, "PROMPT_REQUEST") && bool(e, "pii_detected") && !bool(e, "pii_handling_allowed")) add(out, "GOV-014", e);
51        if (is(e, "PROMPT_REQUEST") && !boolDefault(e, "model_approved", true)) add(out, "GOV-015", e);
52        if (is(e, "PROMPT_REQUEST") && (number(e, "prompt_injection_score") >= 0.8 || bool(e, "data_exfiltration_detected"))) add(out, "GOV-016", e);
53    }
54 
55    private void add(List<ComplianceFinding> out, String ruleId, GovernanceEvent event) {
56        out.add(FindingFactory.create(catalog.get(ruleId), event, 1, null, null, Map.of()));
57    }
58 
59    private static boolean is(GovernanceEvent e, String type) { return type.equals(e.eventType()); }
60    private static Object value(GovernanceEvent e, String key) { return e.attributes().get(key); }
61    private static String text(GovernanceEvent e, String key) { Object v = value(e, key); return v == null ? null : String.valueOf(v); }
62    private static boolean blank(String v) { return v == null || v.isBlank(); }
63    private static boolean bool(GovernanceEvent e, String key) { return boolDefault(e, key, false); }
64    private static boolean boolDefault(GovernanceEvent e, String key, boolean fallback) {
65        Object v = value(e, key);
66        if (v == null) return fallback;
67        return v instanceof Boolean b ? b : Boolean.parseBoolean(String.valueOf(v));
68    }
69    private static double number(GovernanceEvent e, String key) {
70        Object v = value(e, key);
71        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.doubleValue();
72        try { return v == null ? 0 : Double.parseDouble(String.valueOf(v)); }
73        catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { return 0; }
74    }
75}

1package io.governance.serde;
2 
3import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
4import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.SerializationFeature;
5import com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.jsr310.JavaTimeModule;
6import org.apache.kafka.common.errors.SerializationException;
7import org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Deserializer;
8import org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serde;
9import org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serializer;
10 
11import java.util.Map;
12 
13public final class JsonSerde<T> implements Serde<T> {
14    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper()
15            .registerModule(new JavaTimeModule())
16            .disable(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS);
17    private final Class<T> type;
18 
19    public JsonSerde(Class<T> type) { this.type = type; }
20 
21    @Override public Serializer<T> serializer() {
22        return (topic, value) -> {
23            if (value == null) return null;
24            try { return MAPPER.writeValueAsBytes(value); }
25            catch (Exception e) { throw new SerializationException("Cannot serialize " + type.getSimpleName(), e); }
26        };
27    }
28 
29    @Override public Deserializer<T> deserializer() {
30        return (topic, bytes) -> {
31            if (bytes == null) return null;
32            try { return MAPPER.readValue(bytes, type); }
33            catch (Exception e) { throw new SerializationException("Cannot deserialize " + type.getSimpleName(), e); }
34        };
35    }
36 
37    @Override public void configure(Map<String, ?> configs, boolean isKey) {}
38    @Override public void close() {}
39}

7public final class EventTimestampExtractor implements TimestampExtractor {

1package io.governance.streams;
2 
3import io.governance.model.ComplianceFinding;
4import io.governance.model.GovernanceEvent;
5import io.governance.model.LoginBurst;
6import io.governance.model.ModelEvidence;
7import io.governance.model.PromotionCheck;
8import io.governance.rules.FindingFactory;
9import io.governance.rules.RuleCatalog;
10import io.governance.rules.StatelessRuleEngine;
11import io.governance.serde.JsonSerde;
12import org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serdes;
13import org.apache.kafka.common.utils.Bytes;
14import org.apache.kafka.streams.KeyValue;
15import org.apache.kafka.streams.StreamsBuilder;
16import org.apache.kafka.streams.Topology;
17import org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.Consumed;
18import org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.Joined;
19import org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.KStream;
20import org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.KTable;
21import org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.Materialized;
22import org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.Produced;
23import org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.TimeWindows;
24import org.apache.kafka.streams.state.KeyValueStore;
25import org.apache.kafka.streams.state.WindowStore;
26 
27import java.time.Duration;
28import java.time.Instant;
29import java.util.ArrayList;
30import java.util.List;
31import java.util.Map;
32 
33public final class GovernanceTopology {
34    public static final List<String> INPUT_TOPICS = List.of(
35            "governance.keycloak.v1",
36            "governance.kubernetes.v1",
37            "governance.pipeline.v1",
38            "governance.model-registry.v1",
39            "governance.llm-gateway.v1"
40    );
41    public static final String OUTPUT_TOPIC = "governance.findings.raw.v1";
42 
43    private final RuleCatalog catalog;
44    private final StatelessRuleEngine ruleEngine;
45    private final JsonSerde<GovernanceEvent> eventSerde = new JsonSerde<>(GovernanceEvent.class);
46    private final JsonSerde<ComplianceFinding> findingSerde = new JsonSerde<>(ComplianceFinding.class);
47 
48    public GovernanceTopology(RuleCatalog catalog) {
49        this.catalog = catalog;
50        this.ruleEngine = new StatelessRuleEngine(catalog);
51    }
52 
53    public Topology build() {
54        StreamsBuilder builder = new StreamsBuilder();
55        KStream<String, GovernanceEvent> events = builder.stream(
56                INPUT_TOPICS,
57                Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), eventSerde).withTimestampExtractor(new EventTimestampExtractor())
58        ).filter((key, event) -> event != null);
59 
60        KStream<String, ComplianceFinding> stateless = events.flatMapValues(ruleEngine::evaluate);
61        KStream<String, ComplianceFinding> failedLoginBursts = failedLoginTopology(events);
62        KStream<String, ComplianceFinding> promotionChecks = promotionTopology(events);
63 
64        stateless.merge(failedLoginBursts).merge(promotionChecks)
65                .selectKey((key, finding) -> finding.findingId())
66                .to(OUTPUT_TOPIC, Produced.with(Serdes.String(), findingSerde));
67 
68        return builder.build();
69    }
70 
71    private KStream<String, ComplianceFinding> failedLoginTopology(KStream<String, GovernanceEvent> events) {
72        JsonSerde<LoginBurst> burstSerde = new JsonSerde<>(LoginBurst.class);
73        KTable<org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.Windowed<String>, LoginBurst> bursts = events
74                .filter((key, event) -> event.producer() == GovernanceEvent.Producer.KEYCLOAK
75                        && "LOGIN_FAILURE".equals(event.eventType()) && event.actor() != null)
76                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.actor().id())
77                .groupByKey(org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), eventSerde))
78                .windowedBy(TimeWindows.ofSizeAndGrace(Duration.ofMinutes(5), Duration.ofMinutes(1)))
79                .aggregate(
80                        () -> new LoginBurst(null, null, null, null, null, 0),
81                        (actorId, event, aggregate) -> LoginBurst.add(aggregate, event),
82                        Materialized.<String, LoginBurst, WindowStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as("failed-login-five-minute-window")
83                                .withKeySerde(Serdes.String()).withValueSerde(burstSerde).withCachingDisabled()
84                );
85 
86        return bursts.toStream()
87                .filter((windowedActor, burst) -> burst != null && burst.count() == 5 && burst.thresholdEventId() != null)
88                .map((windowedActor, burst) -> {
89                    Instant start = Instant.ofEpochMilli(windowedActor.window().start());
90                    Instant end = Instant.ofEpochMilli(windowedActor.window().end());
91                    GovernanceEvent synthetic = new GovernanceEvent(
92                            "1.0", burst.thresholdEventId(), burst.thresholdEventTime(), burst.thresholdEventTime(),
93                            GovernanceEvent.Producer.KEYCLOAK, "LOGIN_FAILURE",
94                            new GovernanceEvent.Actor(windowedActor.key(), "USER", List.of(), null, null),
95                            new GovernanceEvent.Subject("IDENTITY", windowedActor.key(), null, null, null, null),
96                            "authenticate", GovernanceEvent.Outcome.FAILURE, "prod", burst.thresholdEventId(), null,
97                            Map.of(), Map.of()
98                    );
99                    ComplianceFinding finding = FindingFactory.create(
100                            catalog.get("GOV-001"), synthetic, burst.count(), start, end,
101                            Map.of("first_event_id", burst.firstEventId(), "failed_login_count", burst.count())
102                    );
103                    return KeyValue.pair(finding.findingId(), finding);
104                });
105    }
106 
107    private KStream<String, ComplianceFinding> promotionTopology(KStream<String, GovernanceEvent> events) {
108        JsonSerde<ModelEvidence> evidenceSerde = new JsonSerde<>(ModelEvidence.class);
109        JsonSerde<PromotionCheck> checkSerde = new JsonSerde<>(PromotionCheck.class);
110 
111        KTable<String, GovernanceEvent> approvals = events
112                .filter((key, event) -> event.producer() == GovernanceEvent.Producer.MODEL_REGISTRY
113                        && "APPROVAL_GRANTED".equals(event.eventType()) && event.modelKey() != null)
114                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.modelKey())
115                .toTable(Materialized.<String, GovernanceEvent, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as("model-approval-state")
116                        .withKeySerde(Serdes.String()).withValueSerde(eventSerde));
117 
118        KTable<String, GovernanceEvent> evaluations = events
119                .filter((key, event) -> event.producer() == GovernanceEvent.Producer.PIPELINE
120                        && "MODEL_EVALUATION_COMPLETED".equals(event.eventType()) && event.modelKey() != null
121                        && Boolean.TRUE.equals(event.attributes().get("passed")))
122                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.modelKey())
123                .toTable(Materialized.<String, GovernanceEvent, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as("model-evaluation-state")
124                        .withKeySerde(Serdes.String()).withValueSerde(eventSerde));
125 
126        KTable<String, ModelEvidence> evidence = approvals.outerJoin(
127                evaluations,
128                ModelEvidence::new,
129                Materialized.<String, ModelEvidence, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as("model-governance-evidence")
130                        .withKeySerde(Serdes.String()).withValueSerde(evidenceSerde)
131        );
132 
133        KStream<String, PromotionCheck> checks = events
134                .filter((key, event) -> event.producer() == GovernanceEvent.Producer.MODEL_REGISTRY
135                        && "MODEL_PROMOTED".equals(event.eventType()) && "prod".equals(event.environment())
136                        && event.modelKey() != null)
137                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.modelKey())
138                .leftJoin(evidence, PromotionCheck::new, Joined.with(Serdes.String(), eventSerde, evidenceSerde));
139 
140        return checks.flatMapValues(check -> {
141            List<ComplianceFinding> findings = new ArrayList<>();
142            ModelEvidence modelEvidence = check.evidence();
143            if (modelEvidence == null || modelEvidence.approval() == null) {
144                findings.add(FindingFactory.create(catalog.get("GOV-011"), check.promotion(), 1, null, null,
145                        Map.of("model_key", check.promotion().modelKey(), "approval_present", false)));
146            }
147            if (modelEvidence == null || modelEvidence.evaluation() == null) {
148                findings.add(FindingFactory.create(catalog.get("GOV-012"), check.promotion(), 1, null, null,
149                        Map.of("model_key", check.promotion().modelKey(), "evaluation_present", false)));
150            }
151            return findings;
152        });
153    }
154}

13 
14import java.time.Instant;
15import java.util.List;
16import java.util.Map;
17import java.util.Properties;
18 
19import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
20 
21class GovernanceTopologyTest {
22    @Test void emitsOneBurstFindingOnTheFifthFailure() {
23        Properties p = new Properties();
24        p.put(StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_ID_CONFIG, "test");
25        p.put(StreamsConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG, "dummy:9092");
26        try (TopologyTestDriver driver = new TopologyTestDriver(new GovernanceTopology(RuleCatalog.load()).build(), p)) {
27            JsonSerde<GovernanceEvent> eventSerde = new JsonSerde<>(GovernanceEvent.class);
28            JsonSerde<ComplianceFinding> findingSerde = new JsonSerde<>(ComplianceFinding.class);
29            TestInputTopic<String, GovernanceEvent> input = driver.createInputTopic(
30                    "governance.keycloak.v1", Serdes.String().serializer(), eventSerde.serializer());
31            TestOutputTopic<String, ComplianceFinding> output = driver.createOutputTopic(
32                    GovernanceTopology.OUTPUT_TOPIC, Serdes.String().deserializer(), findingSerde.deserializer());
33 
34            Instant start = Instant.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z");
35            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) input.pipeInput("alice", failedLogin(i, start.plusSeconds(i * 20L)), start.plusSeconds(i * 20L));
36 
37            List<ComplianceFinding> findings = output.readValuesToList();
38            assertEquals(1, findings.size());
39            assertEquals("GOV-001", findings.getFirst().ruleId());
40            assertEquals(5, findings.getFirst().frequency());
41        }
42    }
43 
44    @Test void promotionWithoutStateEmitsTwoFindings() {
45        Properties p = new Properties();
46        p.put(StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_ID_CONFIG, "test-promotion");
47        p.put(StreamsConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG, "dummy:9092");
48        try (TopologyTestDriver driver = new TopologyTestDriver(new GovernanceTopology(RuleCatalog.load()).build(), p)) {
49            JsonSerde<GovernanceEvent> eventSerde = new JsonSerde<>(GovernanceEvent.class);
50            JsonSerde<ComplianceFinding> findingSerde = new JsonSerde<>(ComplianceFinding.class);
51            TestInputTopic<String, GovernanceEvent> input = driver.createInputTopic(
52                    "governance.model-registry.v1", Serdes.String().serializer(), eventSerde.serializer());
53            TestOutputTopic<String, ComplianceFinding> output = driver.createOutputTopic(
54                    GovernanceTopology.OUTPUT_TOPIC, Serdes.String().deserializer(), findingSerde.deserializer());
55            input.pipeInput("credit:7", modelPromotion(), Instant.parse("2026-01-01T01:00:00Z"));
56            assertEquals(List.of("GOV-011", "GOV-012"), output.readValuesToList().stream().map(ComplianceFinding::ruleId).toList());
57        }
58    }
59 
60    private GovernanceEvent failedLogin(int index, Instant at) {
61        return new GovernanceEvent("1.0", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000" + index, at, at,
62                GovernanceEvent.Producer.KEYCLOAK, "LOGIN_FAILURE",
63                new GovernanceEvent.Actor("alice", "USER", List.of(), null, null),
64                new GovernanceEvent.Subject("IDENTITY", "alice", null, null, null, null),
65                "authenticate", GovernanceEvent.Outcome.FAILURE, "prod", "burst", null, Map.of(), Map.of());
66    }
67 
68    private GovernanceEvent modelPromotion() {
69        Instant at = Instant.parse("2026-01-01T01:00:00Z");
70        return new GovernanceEvent("1.0", "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", at, at,
71                GovernanceEvent.Producer.MODEL_REGISTRY, "MODEL_PROMOTED",
72                new GovernanceEvent.Actor("release-bot", "SERVICE", List.of(), null, null),
73                new GovernanceEvent.Subject("MODEL", "credit:7", null, "credit", "7", null),
74                "promote", GovernanceEvent.Outcome.SUCCESS, "prod", "promotion", null, Map.of(), Map.of());
75    }

1#!/usr/bin/env bash
2set -euo pipefail
3 
4ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

7DB_INSTANCE="${DB_INSTANCE:-ai-governance-postgres}"
8NAMESPACE="${NAMESPACE:-governance}"
9TUNNEL_POD="tableau-rds-tunnel"
10LOCAL_SOURCE_PORT="${LOCAL_SOURCE_PORT:-15432}"
11EXPORT_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/aws-tableau-refresh.XXXXXX")"
12PORT_FORWARD_PID=""
13 
14cleanup() {
15  if [[ -n "$PORT_FORWARD_PID" ]]; then
16    kill "$PORT_FORWARD_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
17    wait "$PORT_FORWARD_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
18  fi
19  kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" delete pod "$TUNNEL_POD" --ignore-not-found >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
20  find "$EXPORT_DIR" -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
21  rmdir "$EXPORT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
22  unset SOURCE_PASSWORD
23}
24trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
25 
26for command in aws kubectl docker python3; do
27  command -v "$command" >/dev/null || {
28    echo "Required command is missing: $command" >&2
29    exit 1
30  }
31done
32 
33cd "$ROOT_DIR"
34aws sts get-caller-identity >/dev/null
35aws eks update-kubeconfig --name "$EKS_CLUSTER" --region "$AWS_REGION" >/dev/null
36 
37docker compose up -d postgres >/dev/null
38until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U governance -d governance >/dev/null 2>&1; do
39  sleep 1
40done
41docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U governance -d governance \
42  < tableau/aws_reporting_schema.sql >/dev/null
43 
44kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" delete pod "$TUNNEL_POD" --ignore-not-found >/dev/null
45kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" run "$TUNNEL_POD" \
46  --image=alpine/socat \
47  --restart=Never \
48  -- TCP-LISTEN:5432,fork,reuseaddr \
49  "TCP:$(aws rds describe-db-instances \
50    --db-instance-identifier "$DB_INSTANCE" \
51    --region "$AWS_REGION" \
52    --query 'DBInstances[0].Endpoint.Address' \
53    --output text):5432" >/dev/null
54kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" wait --for=condition=Ready "pod/$TUNNEL_POD" --timeout=90s >/dev/null
55 
56kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" port-forward "pod/$TUNNEL_POD" \
57  "$LOCAL_SOURCE_PORT:5432" >"$EXPORT_DIR/port-forward.log" 2>&1 &
58PORT_FORWARD_PID=$!
59 
60python3 - "$LOCAL_SOURCE_PORT" <<'PY'
61import socket
62import sys
63import time
64 
65port = int(sys.argv[1])
66for _ in range(60):
67    try:
68        with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=1):
69            break
70    except OSError:
71        time.sleep(0.5)
72else:
73    raise SystemExit("The private RDS tunnel did not become ready")
74PY

76SECRET_ARN="$(aws rds describe-db-instances \
